title: agent-atlas Orchestrator manifest
description: The single control plane. It owns the deterministic control flow — deciding which task/agent runs, in what order, and on what condition — and externalizes run state. There is one orchestrator per model; the tasks are its children.

control_flow.description: How the orchestrator expresses control flow: a state machine, a DAG, or a simple sequence.

state_store.description: id of a System (kind=state-store) where run/step state is externalized.
